recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition featuring a crouched male figure in a leather jacket and beanie, set against a blown-out white background. A vintage motorcycle and a hand-drawn cross icon appear in the mid-ground, while dramatic blackletter typography anchors the top left.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, shadowed figure acts as a heavy visual weight against the negative white space.
The motorcycle provides a secondary thematic element that balances the figure's crouched posture.
The red-tinted blackletter title creates a focal point of color and cultural identity.
The vertical dark band on the right edge frames the subject and adds depth.
coreInvariants: Extreme chiaroscuro lighting with blown-out highlights.
Desaturated color palette with a single deep red accent.
Rough, textured edges on secondary graphic elements like the cross.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large crouched figure occupying the lower right and center-right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the figure's leather jacket and head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red typography, moves down to the motorcycle, and settles on the shadowed figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white void on the left side and top center, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-key contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and clothing textures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark oxblood red for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Near-zero saturation except for the title; extreme value range from 0 to 100.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with sharp, angular terminals.
Extended decorative swashes on initial capital letters.
Condensed width to maintain a vertical rhythm.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'B' and 'G' feature exaggerated calligraphic flourishes.
Lower-case letters are tightly kerned with spiked tops.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, ornate blackletter paired with a clean, widely-spaced classical serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the traditional gothic weight and spiked terminals.
Appropriate for the all-caps, widely spaced subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a man in a leather jacket and beanie crouched in prayer or contemplation. Use a blown-out white background. Include a vintage motorcycle silhouette in the mid-ground left. Add a vertical dark door frame on the far right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a dark red blackletter font for the main name in the top left. Below it, add a subtitle in a light serif font, all caps, with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without gray tones?
Is the red text the only significant color in the image?
Is the motorcycle silhouette slightly distressed or grainy?
Is the man's face mostly obscured by shadow?

adjustableVariables: Amount of detail visible in the leather jacket shadows
Position of the motorcycle relative to the figure
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the cross icon is a generic hand-drawn style
Modify the motorcycle model to be a generic cruiser
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black and pure white clipping.
Verify the red text is legible against the white.
Ensure the crouched figure feels heavy and grounded.
Confirm the wide tracking on the subtitle is distinct.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photography + Blown-out negative space + Ornate Blackletter + Minimal Red Accent.
